"""Bind existing component and inert-runner QA to exact staged source bytes."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RUNNER = 'experiments/r4_integrated/public_qa_acquisition.py'


def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def main():
    runner = ROOT / RUNNER
    tree = ast.parse(runner.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    paths = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body
                 if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(
                     isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'SOURCE_PATHS' for t in n.targets))
    source_files = {p: digest(ROOT / p) for p in paths}
    for name in paths:
        staged = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', ':' + name], cwd=ROOT)
        assert (ROOT / name).read_bytes() == staged, name
    qa_path = ROOT / '.pytest-tmp/public-qa-runner-inert-qa.json'
    qa = json.loads(qa_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert qa['status'] == 'passed'
    assert qa['source_sha256'][RUNNER] == source_files[RUNNER]
    for name, expected in qa['source_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / name) == expected, name
    checker = ROOT / '.pytest-tmp/audit_public_qa_runner_inert.py'
    assert digest(checker) == qa['checker_sha256']
    assert checker.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == qa['checker_source']
    bundle_path = ROOT / 'benchmarks/public_qa_preparation_v1.json'
    bundle = json.loads(bundle_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert digest(bundle_path) == '72d3eda7f0f760887f34398b45e2df945c163a3a1c86df0a48b7e56a53a6d4cf'
    qualified = bundle['conventional_v2_handoff']['content']
    assert qualified['status'] == 'passed_synthetic_v2_qualification'
    assert qualified['tests_passed'] == 6 and qualified['toy_final_correct'] == [True] * 3
    for name, expected in qualified['source_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(ROOT / name) == expected, name
    custody_path = ROOT / '.pytest-tmp/public-qa-checkout-line-ending-custody.json'
    custody = json.loads(custody_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    original = custody['original_utf8'].encode('utf-8')
    assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() == custody['before_sha256']
    assert original.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n') == (ROOT / custody['path']).read_bytes()
    assert digest(ROOT / custody['path']) == custody['after_sha256']
    envelope = {
        'status': 'passed',
        'scope': 'Qualified conventional v2 and source-bound inert schedule/failure QA; no target fit',
        'source_files': source_files,
        'component_evidence': {
            'path': str(bundle_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': digest(bundle_path),
            'qualification': bundle['qualification'],
            'qualified_source_sha256': qualified['source_sha256'],
        },
        'runner_qa': {'path': str(qa_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                      'sha256': digest(qa_path), 'receipt': qa},
        'checkout_line_ending_custody': {k: v for k, v in custody.items() if k != 'original_utf8'},
        'builder': {'path': str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)),
                    'sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
                    'source': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')},
    }
    out = ROOT / '.pytest-tmp/public-qa-preparation-attestation.json'
    with out.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
        json.dump(envelope, stream, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps({'path': str(out), 'sha256': digest(out), 'status': envelope['status'],
                      'source_files': len(source_files)}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
